description: PDF text. Send a public PDF URL or the file as base64 (up to 10 MB); returns the plain text of each page, the page count, the title and a truncated flag (first 200 pages and 2,000,000 characters). Use to read reports, papers, filings or invoices. No OCR: scanned pages come back empty (send page images to /v1/ocr); encrypted PDFs are refused. Typical response 1 to 5 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.01 (USDC, x402).

pdf_base64.description: The PDF file as base64, up to 10 MB decoded. Send url or pdf_base64.

url.description: Public http or https URL of the PDF.
